title: Detailed piano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Piano body main -->
  <rect x="12" y="18" width="76" height="52" rx="3" fill="#7B1E1E"/>
  <!-- Body top highlight -->
  <rect x="12" y="18" width="76" height="6" rx="3" fill="#9B3030"/>
  <!-- Lid -->
  <rect x="16" y="14" width="68" height="8" rx="2" fill="#5A1414"/>
  <rect x="16" y="14" width="68" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#7B1E1E"/>
  <!-- Music desk area -->
  <rect x="22" y="28" width="56" height="18" rx="2" fill="#3D0D0D"/>
  <rect x="24" y="30" width="52" height="14" rx="1" fill="#5A1414"/>
  <!-- Sheet music -->
  <rect x="28" y="32" width="20" height="12" rx="1" fill="#F5E6C8"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="35" x2="46" y2="35" stroke="#C4A882" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="38" x2="46" y2="38" stroke="#C4A882" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="41" x2="46" y2="41" stroke="#C4A882" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="52" y="32" width="20" height="12" rx="1" fill="#F5E6C8"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="35" x2="70" y2="35" stroke="#C4A882" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="38" x2="70" y2="38" stroke="#C4A882" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="41" x2="70" y2="41" stroke="#C4A882" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Front panel above keys -->
  <rect x="12" y="50" width="76" height="8" fill="#6B1818"/>
  <rect x="12" y="50" width="76" height="2" fill="#8A2828"/>
  <!-- Keyboard base -->
  <rect x="10" y="58" width="80" height="14" rx="1" fill="#1A0A0A"/>
  <!-- White keys -->
  <g fill="#FFF8EE">
    <rect x="12" y="59" width="7" height="12" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="20" y="59" width="7" height="12" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="28" y="59" width="7" height="12" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="36" y="59" width="7" height="12" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="44" y="59" width="7" height="12" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="52" y="59" width="7" height="12" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="60" y="59" width="7" height="12" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="68" y="59" width="7" height="12" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="76" y="59" width="7" height="12" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="84" y="59" width="6" height="12" rx="0.5"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Key separators -->
  <g stroke="#D4C8B8" stroke-width="0.5">
    <line x1="19.5" y1="59" x2="19.5" y2="71"/>
    <line x1="27.5" y1="59" x2="27.5" y2="71"/>
    <line x1="35.5" y1="59" x2="35.5" y2="71"/>
    <line x1="43.5" y1="59" x2="43.5" y2="71"/>
    <line x1="51.5" y1="59" x2="51.5" y2="71"/>
    <line x1="59.5" y1="59" x2="59.5" y2="71"/>
    <line x1="67.5" y1="59" x2="67.5" y2="71"/>
    <line x1="75.5" y1="59" x2="75.5" y2="71"/>
    <line x1="83.5" y1="59" x2="83.5" y2="71"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Black keys -->
  <g fill="#2A1010">
    <rect x="16" y="59" width="4" height="7" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="24" y="59" width="4" height="7" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="40" y="59" width="4" height="7" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="48" y="59" width="4" height="7" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="56" y="59" width="4" height="7" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="64" y="59" width="4" height="7" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="72" y="59" width="4" height="7" rx="0.5"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Black key highlights -->
  <g fill="#5A2020">
    <rect x="17" y="59" width="2" height="3" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="25" y="59" width="2" height="3" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="41" y="59" width="2" height="3" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="49" y="59" width="2" height="3" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="57" y="59" width="2" height="3" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="65" y="59" width="2" height="3" rx="0.5"/>
    <rect x="73" y="59" width="2" height="3" rx="0.5"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Bottom of piano -->
  <rect x="10" y="72" width="80" height="4" rx="1" fill="#5A1414"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="16" y="76" width="5" height="14" rx="1" fill="#4A1010"/>
  <rect x="79" y="76" width="5" height="14" rx="1" fill="#4A1010"/>
  <!-- Pedals -->
  <rect x="38" y="82" width="10" height="4" rx="1" fill="#C8A84B"/>
  <rect x="52" y="82" width="10" height="4" rx="1" fill="#C8A84B"/>
  <!-- Pedal rods -->
  <line x1="43" y1="80" x2="43" y2="82" stroke="#A88830" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="57" y1="80" x2="57" y2="82" stroke="#A88830" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Decorative panel lines on body -->
  <rect x="18" y="48" width="64" height="1" fill="#9B3030"/>
  <!-- Side highlight -->
  <rect x="12" y="24" width="2" height="34" fill="#9B3030" opacity="0.5"/>
  <rect x="86" y="24" width="2" height="34" fill="#4A1010" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- Music stand edge highlight -->
  <rect x="22" y="27" width="56" height="1" fill="#8A2828"/>
</svg>
